prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 19 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1262; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of right shoulder pain, restricted range of motion, and intermittent numbness radiating into the right upper arm. Initial examination revealed decreased active abduction and forward flexion of the right shoulder, tenderness over the anterior joint line, and positive impingement signs. Imaging was reviewed and showed no acute fracture or dislocation, with findings consistent with a partial-thickness rotator cuff strain.

Over the course of 19 visits, treatment consisted of a structured physical therapy program focusing on passive and active-assisted range of motion, progressive rotator cuff strengthening, and scapular stabilization exercises. Adjunctive modalities including ultrasound and cryotherapy were used for symptom control, and a corticosteroid injection was administered once during the early phase of care.

By the final visit, the patient demonstrated substantial improvement in pain levels and functional range of motion, with residual mild weakness on resisted external rotation. The patient was advised to continue a home exercise program and to report any recurrence of numbness or progressive weakness. Discharge from active care was recommended with follow-up as needed.
